To rewrite the same line you just wrote, only in cursive.

entries.word: WordPlay in EveryWay helps 2 keep the Dr. away!

entries.definition: To follow a tiny cultural signal before it grows loud enough to be called a trend.
A chain of related puns that keeps branching from one word into a whole island system of wordplay.
A person who catches the faintest hint of a word and follows it until language starts drawing its own conclusions.
An ancient version of an idea that keeps lumbering back into the newest draft.
The path an idea takes when one metaphor pulls it into the gravity of another.
A visual idea tested by changing the typography until the words prove what they mean.
A tiny change in meaning that latches onto a sentence and refuses to let go.
The movement of an odd little idea from one mind to another until it becomes shared creative currency.
A thought that returns from someone else's mind carrying a meaning you never put into it.
The distinctive verbal trace a person leaves behind when their way of arranging words becomes unmistakably their own.
The hidden weave of circumstances that makes the same words mean something different depending on where they land.
An unplanned journey away from the original thought because one irresistible word opened a better road.
The sudden clarity that appears when you finally find a name for the thing you've been circling around.
The better idea that arrives just after you were certain the thinking was finished.
